prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Silver (은) itself — the sovereign of the Silver Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing. Age: late twenties — a settled, mature adult face with defined cheekbones; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Her: an adult woman in her late twenties with a compact heart-shaped face, porcelain skin, naturally open amethyst eyes, sharply defined upper lashes and a focused composed expression; a curvy athletic full-busted figure. Liquid mirror-silver hair reflecting cold blue moonlight, worn in a layered short pixie cut with asymmetrical feathered bangs.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes keep the shape described above at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Her element: silver: the moon's metal — the brightest mirror shine of any metal, coins and cutlery, silver bullets against monsters in legend, the silvered plates that held the first photographs; it tarnishes black wherever sulfur touches it; cold, pure and reflective. Palette: moonlit silver, mirror white, tarnish black, cold blue moonlight.

World and costume: year 2200, a space mirror observatory: a city of folding mirror petals unfurled like a giant telescope, cold blue moonlight, the stars doubled in every surface. MECHA DESIGN: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. mirror-polished silver armor that reflects the scene around her, cold blue moonlight glow lines, patches of black tarnish etched like filigree at the edges, a back unit of folding mirror petals like a space telescope; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.

Outfit silhouette: large wing-shaped binder plates spread symmetrically behind her back as the main shape, with articulated body armor. Signature construction: both binder wings are segmented hexagonal silver mirror arrays, like the silver-coated folding primary mirror of a space telescope; each black-tarnished rim houses a cold-blue actuator and every panel has a visible hinge. A compact white-silver breastplate, segmented waist and hip plates, knee and shin armor with exposed articulated joint housings. Her whole body wears substantial hard-surface mecha armour with visible thickness, joints and panel lines, her face and hair human. The open neckline and small purposeful skin windows at upper arms and upper thighs provide bold exposure; intimate areas securely covered by opaque armor. No cloth, gown, fabric skirt, royal mantle, crown or long cape plates. Both hands human and empty.

EXPOSURE (bold): her outer layer (coat, cloak, robe or armor) stays on both shoulders, worn symmetrically; skin shows through the inner garment — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, slits where the form allows. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.

Pose: a steady wide-balanced stance on an orbital maintenance deck, one shoulder slightly forward, both empty hands open and visible at her sides. Expression: focused direct gaze and a restrained confident closed-mouth smile. Setting: a year-2200 space mirror observatory outside Earth's atmosphere, gigantic folding mirror petals behind her and cold-blue Earthlight across the metal deck, distant stars.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Ag) and atomic number (47) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
